story.title: iCloud+ Hide My Email addresses will remain on icloud.com

draft:
iCloud+ is keeping Hide My Email on icloud.com, not moving it to a new domain.

Apple’s decision means the disposable aliases stay under the same trusted domain that users already recognize. For developers, this reduces the risk of spam filters flagging messages from a new domain and simplifies integration with existing email‑validation logic. For privacy‑conscious users, it reinforces Apple’s strategy of keeping the “invisible” layer of communication within its ecosystem, which may boost confidence in adopting the feature more broadly.

I’m curious: will the continued use of icloud.com make Hide My Email a more compelling alternative to third‑party alias services, or will users still gravitate toward solutions that offer greater customization?
